concept: 引离手法在钩杀中的作用
concept_en: The Role of Deflection in Hook Mate
question_cn: 钩杀前为何常用将军或吃子来引离对方王？
question_en: Why use a check or capture to deflect the enemy king before a hook mate?

options.text_cn: 为了获得物质优势，多吃一个子
options.text_en: To gain a material advantage by winning an extra piece

options.text_cn: 把王驱赶到特定格子，使其暴露在钩杀阵型的攻击范围内
options.text_en: Drive the king to a specific square where it falls into the hook-mate net

options.text_cn: 逼迫对方王进入己方领地
options.text_en: Force the enemy king into your territory

options.text_cn: 清除本方棋子的前进道路
options.text_en: Clear the path for one of your own pieces

explanation_cn: 引离手法（通常是将军或强吃）的目的是强迫王走到特定格子，进入钩杀阵型的覆盖范围。王别无选择，只能就范，最终被封死将死。
explanation_en: A deflection, usually delivered with check or a forcing capture, drives the king onto a specific square inside the hook-mate net. With no safe alternative, the king is forced into the mating position.
